messages:
jenna_support: Hey team — customer Alex (alex@acme.co) reporting production errors since 03:00 UTC. They say the model is calling the wrong tool variant and we get a schema validation 400. Pasting logs below.

alex_acme: Confirming. Started when we rolled new prompt set at ~02:55. Calls that should hit `account_lookup` are resolving to `user_lookup` and payload fields mismatch (we send account_id, tool expects user_id). 50% of calls fail.

alex_acme: Log snippet: ```
2026-03-17T02:59:12Z ERROR tool_router: selected_tool="user_lookup" expected_tools=["account_lookup"] req_id=bbf2c
2026-03-17T02:59:12Z ERROR validate_schema: tool=user_lookup err="missing required field: user_id" payload={"account_id":"acct_123","context":{...}}
HTTP 400 response sent to client id=acct_123 request_id=bbf2c
```

jenna_support: Thanks. Can you paste the request body you send from the app? Any tool_selector hints in the call?

alex_acme: Here's the sanitized request we send to Redwood: ```json
{
  \"model\": \"redwood-rlm-1\",
  \"input\": \"lookup account for acct_123\",
  \"tools_metadata\": [\"account_lookup\", \"user_lookup\"],
  \"tool_selector_hint\": \"account_lookup\",
  \"metadata\": {\"tenant\": \"acme\"}
}
```

mark_sre: Noted. Two quick hypotheses: 1) router polyselect picks the higher-scoring tool from the model output instead of honoring explicit hint; 2) recent kernel routing change for short inputs may remap tool aliases.

alan_re: I see a related spike in routing metrics around 02:54-03:05. `tool_choice_confidence` for acct tenant dropped to 0.42. Full trace: route decided by scoring_model v3.2 (deployed 2026-03-17T02:50).

deploy_bot: deploy event: scoring_model v3.2 promoted to prod at 2026-03-17T02:50 by @releases. Change ID: rel-2026-03-17-322.

mark_sre: Ok can we reproduce locally? Steps: 1) use the customer's request body; 2) force model to produce tool call tokens; 3) run through router with scoring_model v3.2.

alan_re: Reproduced in staging with v3.2. Behavior: model emits tool tag `user_lookup` when prompt phrase includes singular "user" tokens in system message. The new scoring_model gives slight boost to `user_lookup` for short context.

jenna_support: Mitigation for customer: temporarily pin to scoring_model v3.1 (previous) or remove `user_lookup` from tools_metadata until we patch. Alex, which is easier for you?

alex_acme: We can pin if you provide the param. Prefer temporary pin over changing our client. Will that require downtime?

mark_sre: No downtime. Use query param: `router_config=scoring_model:v3.1` in your request to force older scorer. Example: `POST /v1/generate?router_config=scoring_model:v3.1`

alan_re: Also filing a follow-up: will add an explicit honor-hint flag so `tool_selector_hint` is enforced when present in request. Issue: RED-8721.

jenna_support: Alex — I created a ticket RED-8721 and pinned your account to v3.1 for the next 6 hours. Please test and report.

alex_acme: Confirmed — after adding `router_config=scoring_model:v3.1` error rate dropped to 0%. Thanks.

jenna_support: Next steps for engineering: 1) hotfix: make scorer respect explicit hint when provided (hotfix branch opened by @alan_re). 2) longer-term: add integration test coverage for tool_aliases and scorer interactions. 3) notify releases team to review scoring_model rollout gating.

alan_re: Hotfix PR: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pull/4823 — includes unit + e2e. Will monitor canary.

mark_sre: I'll keep an eye on metrics and rollback if any regression.

jenna_support: Great, closing escalation for now. Please reopen if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
